Our forecast accuracy went from 71% to 94% the quarter we stopped letting reps enter a close date.

The close date is now the date the customer's procurement portal says the PO was cut. If there is no PO, there is no close date, and the deal sits in a stage called "Waiting on paperwork" where the CFO can see it.

Reps hated this for about three weeks. Then two of them noticed their commission cheques arrived on time for the first time since 2023, because finance stopped clawing back deals that closed on the 31st and got signed on the 14th.

Forecast accuracy is 94% because the close-date field is read-only. Procurement fills it in. Procurement is never optimistic.
